verdict.rationale: Docs strongly support the core delegation story: Claude Code plans, writes, tests, commits code, integrates with git/CI/MCP tools, and can run autonomously in background/scheduled/parallel modes (claude-code-docs-2,6,8,28,34). However, community evidence raises significant concerns about reliability of delegated tasks (self-verification failures, degrading quality, high failure rates) that undercut how trustworthy the delegation experience is in practice.
